# QR Platby

> Free QR code generator for Slovak and Czech bank payments. Supports PAY by square (BySquare), EPC QR (SEPA), and SPAYD (QR Platba) formats. Provides both a web app and a REST API. No authentication required.

## Web App

The web app lets users create QR codes for Slovak and Czech banking payments. Payment data entered in the web app stays in the browser (localStorage); share links carry it in the URL fragment.

- [Home - Generate QR Code](https://qr-platby.com): Single payment form with IBAN, amount, symbols, recipient, and note
- [Bulk QR Generation](https://qr-platby.com/bulk): Upload CSV to generate QR codes in batch, export as PDF or ZIP
- [How to Create a Payment QR Code](https://qr-platby.com/en/how-to-create-payment-qr-code): Step-by-step guide with format explainer and FAQ (SK: /ako-vytvorit-qr-kod-na-platbu, CS: /cs/jak-vytvorit-qr-kod-pro-platbu)
- [SEPA QR Code Generator (EPC QR)](https://qr-platby.com/en/sepa-qr-code-generator): What EPC QR is, which EU banking apps scan it (SK/CS: /sepa-qr-kod-generator)
- [Guides index](https://qr-platby.com/en/guides): All how-to and explainer pages (SK/CS: /navody)
- [FAQ (SK)](https://qr-platby.com/#faq): Frequently asked questions about QR payments
- [FAQ (EN)](https://qr-platby.com/en#faq): FAQ in English
- [FAQ (CS)](https://qr-platby.com/cs#faq): FAQ in Czech

Available in Slovak, English, and Czech (Slovak has no prefix; English and Czech use `/en` and `/cs`).

## Privacy

In the web app, payment data is processed in the browser and is not sent to the server. Payment history and settings are stored in localStorage only. The server sees anonymous usage events, a counter ping per generated code, REST API requests (processed, not stored), and feature requests a user chooses to send, optionally with an email.

## API

Single REST endpoint for programmatic QR code generation. Free, no API key needed.

- [API Documentation (JSON)](https://qr-platby.com/api/v1/qr): `GET` returns machine-readable docs, `POST` generates QR codes
- [OpenAPI Specification](https://qr-platby.com/openapi.json): OpenAPI 3.1 spec for the QR generation API
- [Full API Reference](https://qr-platby.com/llms-full.txt): Complete parameters, response schemas, error codes, and examples
- [Usage Stats](https://qr-platby.com/api/v1/stats): `GET` returns anonymous usage counters `{ total, last30Days, api }` - no auth, no PII

### Quick Example

```bash
curl -X POST https://qr-platby.com/api/v1/qr \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"iban":"SK3112000000198742637541","amount":25.50,"variableSymbol":"2024001","recipientName":"Ján Novák"}'
```

Returns JSON with `success: true` and a `data` field containing a base64 PNG data URI of the QR code. A PAY by square request without `recipientName` still succeeds and adds a `warnings` array.

### Quick Example (SPAYD - Czech)

```bash
curl -X POST https://qr-platby.com/api/v1/qr \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"iban":"CZ6508000000192000145399","amount":500,"currency":"CZK","paymentFormat":"spayd","variableSymbol":"1234567890"}'
```

### Quick Example (EPC - EU SEPA)

```bash
curl -X POST https://qr-platby.com/api/v1/qr \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"iban":"DE89370400440532013000","amount":100,"paymentFormat":"epc","recipientName":"Max Mustermann","purposeCode":"GDDS"}'
```

### Rate Limits

- 20 requests per minute
- 100 requests per day
- Per IP address, no authentication

## Technical Details

- QR formats: PAY by square (BySquare) - Slovak banking standard, EPC QR - SEPA standard, SPAYD (QR Platba) - Czech banking standard
- Output formats: PNG (base64 data URI) or SVG markup
- CORS enabled for all origins
- Supports Slovak (SK), Czech (CZ), and other EU IBANs
- Currencies: EUR, CZK
- Payment formats: bysquare (Slovak), spayd (Czech), epc (EU SEPA)
- Optional payment fields: `variableSymbol`, `specificSymbol`, `constantSymbol`, `recipientName`, `paymentNote`, `bic` (all formats), `paymentDueDate` (YYYY-MM-DD; bysquare/spayd), `invoiceId` (bysquare), `spaydReference` (spayd), `instantPayment` (boolean; spayd), `purposeCode` (epc). Fields sent for an unsupported format are rejected.
- Optional styling: `darkColor` / `lightColor` (hex `#RRGGBB` or `#RRGGBBAA`), `margin` (0-10), `errorCorrectionLevel` (`L`/`M`/`Q`/`H`)
